name: Halibut
description: Lean white fish with a mild, slightly sweet flavor similar to tilapia but firmer than cod. Has a gentle taste that easily takes on other flavors and is not oily.

name: Atlantic Salmon
description: Rich, buttery, and slightly sweet fish with a moist texture. Flavor can range from mild to robust depending on species. High in omega-3s and distinctly oily.

name: Lake Whitefish
description: Delicate, mild freshwater fish ideal for those who dislike 'fishy' flavors. Medium-firm with large flakes. Though lean, it can have higher omega-3 levels than very lean fish like cod.

name: Chilean Sea Bass
description: Luxurious, rich fish with a buttery, slightly sweet flavor. White, firm flesh separates into large, tender flakes with a silky mouthfeel. High fat content makes it distinctly oily.

name: Bacalao
description: Salted cod that is rehydrated before cooking. Firm, flaky texture with a mild but slightly briny flavor. Lean fish despite its rich culinary applications.

name: Rainbow Trout
description: Mild fish with a delicate, slightly nutty flavor. Flesh is tender, soft, and flaky, ranging from white to pink/orange. Semi-oily with a moist texture and subtle richness.

name: Skate
description: Mildly pronounced flavor similar to scallops or crab. Flesh is soft when raw but firms up when cooked. Wing meat has a distinctive fibrous, fan-like structure and is not oily.

name: Branzino
description: Very mild, slightly sweet Mediterranean fish with a delicate flavor. Lean yet tender, with fine flakes and a light, clean taste. Not an oily fish.

name: Tilapia
description: Extremely mild, neutral-tasting fish with slight sweetness. Firm, fine flake and highly adaptable. Flavor depends on farming conditions; not an oily fish.
